build_rms_layer_norm: build an RMS Layer Normalization module with a given model dimension and optional device and dtype
build_fp32_layer_norm: build a single-precision Layer Normalization module with a given model dimension and optional device and dtype
create_FP32LayerNorm_forward: create a forward pass that applies Layer Normalization in float32 precision then casts back to original dtype
refactor_FP32LayerNorm: refactor the FP32LayerNorm class to cast inputs and parameters to float32 before applying layer normalization
review_FP32LayerNorm: review the FP32LayerNorm class that extends LayerNorm to perform normalization in single-precision float32
